title: Catus · 섬과 친구
description: 섬에 소속된 사람과 표류 중인 사람, 친구 수와 재방문 차이를 살펴봅니다.

tiles.body:
최근 28일에 관측된 사용자 기준입니다. 전체 가입자 통계와 다를 수 있으며, 확인하지 못한 상태는 따로 표시합니다. 날짜별 집계는 한국 시간 기준입니다.

**다른 대시보드:** [첫 섬과 집중](https://us.posthog.com/project/669473/dashboard/2220995) · [오류와 수집 상태](https://us.posthog.com/project/669473/dashboard/2234116)

tiles.title: 섬 소속과 표류 중인 사람
tiles.description: 최근 28일에 활동이나 섬 상태가 기록된 사람을 가장 최근 상태로 나눈 수입니다. 소속 섬이 없는 사람은 표류로, 상태를 확인하지 못한 사람은 별도로 표시합니다.

source.query:
WITH filtered_events AS (SELECT * FROM events WHERE {filters}), active_people AS (
 SELECT person_id
 FROM filtered_events
 WHERE properties.analytics_environment = 'production'
  AND event = 'app_active'
  AND toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Seoul')) >= toDate(toTimeZone(now(), 'Asia/Seoul')) - INTERVAL 27 DAY
  AND timestamp <= now()
 GROUP BY person_id
), latest_snapshots AS (
 SELECT person_id, 1 AS has_snapshot,
  argMax(tuple(toString(properties.island_status)), timestamp) AS snapshot
 FROM filtered_events
 WHERE properties.analytics_environment = 'production'
  AND event = 'social_state_observed'
  AND toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Seoul')) >= toDate(toTimeZone(now(), 'Asia/Seoul')) - INTERVAL 27 DAY
  AND timestamp <= now()
 GROUP BY person_id
), population AS (
 SELECT person_id FROM active_people
 UNION DISTINCT
 SELECT person_id FROM latest_snapshots
), classified AS (
 SELECT p.person_id,
  multiIf(
   ifNull(l.has_snapshot, 0) = 0, '스냅샷 없음',
   tupleElement(l.snapshot, 1) = 'member', '섬 소속',
   tupleElement(l.snapshot, 1) = 'drifting', '표류',
   '미확인'
  ) AS category
 FROM population p
 LEFT JOIN latest_snapshots l ON p.person_id = l.person_id
)
SELECT category AS "구분", count() AS "사용자 수"
FROM classified
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY "사용자 수" DESC

tiles.title: 섬 상태별 다음 날·7일 뒤 재방문
tiles.description: 최근 28일 안에서 처음 확인한 섬 상태별로, 다음 날과 7일 뒤 앱에 다시 온 비율입니다. 가입일 기준이 아니며, 비교할 날짜가 지난 사람만 포함합니다.

source.query:
WITH filtered_events AS (SELECT * FROM events WHERE {filters}), first_snapshot AS (
 SELECT person_id, min(timestamp) AS first_at,
  argMin(tuple(toString(properties.island_status)), timestamp) AS snapshot
 FROM filtered_events
 WHERE properties.analytics_environment = 'production'
  AND event = 'social_state_observed'
  AND toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Seoul')) >= toDate(toTimeZone(now(), 'Asia/Seoul')) - INTERVAL 27 DAY
  AND timestamp <= now()
 GROUP BY person_id
), cohort AS (
 SELECT person_id,
  toDate(toTimeZone(first_at, 'Asia/Seoul')) AS cohort_day,
  multiIf(tupleElement(snapshot, 1) = 'member', '섬 소속', tupleElement(snapshot, 1) = 'drifting', '표류', '미확인') AS island_status
 FROM first_snapshot
), active_days AS (
 SELECT person_id, toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Seoul')) AS active_day
 FROM filtered_events
 WHERE properties.analytics_environment = 'production'
  AND event = 'app_active'
  AND toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Seoul')) >= toDate(toTimeZone(now(), 'Asia/Seoul')) - INTERVAL 27 DAY
  AND timestamp <= now()
 GROUP BY person_id, active_day
), per_user AS (
 SELECT c.person_id, c.island_status, c.cohort_day,
  max(if(a.active_day = c.cohort_day + INTERVAL 1 DAY, 1, 0)) AS returned_d1,
  max(if(a.active_day = c.cohort_day + INTERVAL 7 DAY, 1, 0)) AS returned_d7
 FROM cohort c
 LEFT JOIN active_days a ON c.person_id = a.person_id
 GROUP BY c.person_id, c.island_status, c.cohort_day
), aggregated AS (
 SELECT island_status,
  countIf(cohort_day + INTERVAL 1 DAY < toDate(toTimeZone(now(), 'Asia/Seoul'))) AS d1_n,
  countIf(cohort_day + INTERVAL 1 DAY < toDate(toTimeZone(now(), 'Asia/Seoul')) AND returned_d1 = 1) AS d1_returned,
  countIf(cohort_day + INTERVAL 7 DAY < toDate(toTimeZone(now(), 'Asia/Seoul'))) AS d7_n,
  countIf(cohort_day + INTERVAL 7 DAY < toDate(toTimeZone(now(), 'Asia/Seoul')) AND returned_d7 = 1) AS d7_returned
 FROM per_user
 GROUP BY island_status
)
SELECT island_status AS "첫 관측 섬 상태",
 nullIf(d1_n, 0) AS "D1 성숙 분모",
 if(d1_n = 0, NULL, d1_returned) AS "D1 재방문자",
 round(100.0 * d1_returned / nullIf(d1_n, 0), 2) AS "D1 재방문율 퍼센트",
 nullIf(d7_n, 0) AS "D7 성숙 분모",
 if(d7_n = 0, NULL, d7_returned) AS "D7 재방문자",
 round(100.0 * d7_returned / nullIf(d7_n, 0), 2) AS "D7 재방문율 퍼센트"
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY "첫 관측 섬 상태"

tiles.title: 친구는 평균 몇 명일까
tiles.description: 최근 28일에 친구 수가 확인된 사람들의 평균·중앙 친구 수와 친구가 0명인 비율입니다. 서로 수락한 친구만 세고, 확인하지 못한 사람은 평균에서 제외합니다.

source.query:
WITH filtered_events AS (SELECT * FROM events WHERE {filters}), latest AS (
 SELECT person_id,
  argMax(tuple(toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.friend_count))), timestamp) AS snapshot
 FROM filtered_events
 WHERE properties.analytics_environment = 'production'
  AND event = 'social_state_observed'
  AND toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Seoul')) >= toDate(toTimeZone(now(), 'Asia/Seoul')) - INTERVAL 27 DAY
  AND timestamp <= now()
 GROUP BY person_id
), values_by_user AS (
 SELECT person_id, if(tupleElement(snapshot, 1) >= 0, tupleElement(snapshot, 1), NULL) AS friend_count
 FROM latest
), totals AS (
 SELECT count() AS observed_n, count(friend_count) AS known_n,
  countIf(isNull(friend_count)) AS unknown_n,
  sumIf(friend_count, isNotNull(friend_count)) AS friend_sum,
  countIf(friend_count = 0) AS zero_n,
  (quantileExact(0.5)(friend_count) - quantileExact(0.5)(-friend_count)) / 2.0 AS median_value
 FROM values_by_user
)
SELECT
 if(known_n = 0, NULL, round(friend_sum / known_n, 2)) AS "평균 친구 수",
 if(known_n = 0, NULL, median_value) AS "중앙값 친구 수",
 if(known_n = 0, NULL, round(100.0 * zero_n / known_n, 2)) AS "친구 0명 비율 퍼센트",
 if(observed_n = 0, NULL, known_n) AS "측정 인원",
 if(observed_n = 0, NULL, unknown_n) AS "미확인 인원"
FROM totals

tiles.title: 친구 수별 사용자 분포
tiles.description: 최근 28일에 기록된 최신 친구 수를 기준으로 0명·1명·2~4명·5명 이상인 사람의 수를 보여줍니다. 친구 수를 확인하지 못한 사람은 별도로 표시합니다.

source.query:
WITH filtered_events AS (SELECT * FROM events WHERE {filters}), latest AS (
 SELECT person_id,
  argMax(tuple(toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.friend_count))), timestamp) AS snapshot
 FROM filtered_events
 WHERE properties.analytics_environment = 'production'
  AND event = 'social_state_observed'
  AND toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Seoul')) >= toDate(toTimeZone(now(), 'Asia/Seoul')) - INTERVAL 27 DAY
  AND timestamp <= now()
 GROUP BY person_id
), classified AS (
 SELECT person_id,
  multiIf(tupleElement(snapshot, 1) = 0, '0명', tupleElement(snapshot, 1) = 1, '1명', tupleElement(snapshot, 1) >= 2 AND tupleElement(snapshot, 1) <= 4, '2~4명', tupleElement(snapshot, 1) >= 5, '5명 이상', '미확인') AS bucket
 FROM latest
)
SELECT bucket AS "친구 구간", count() AS "사용자 수"
FROM classified
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY multiIf(bucket = '0명', 1, bucket = '1명', 2, bucket = '2~4명', 3, bucket = '5명 이상', 4, 5)

tiles.title: 친구 수별 7일 뒤 재방문
tiles.description: 최근 28일 안에서 처음 상태를 확인했을 때 섬에 소속되어 있던 사람을 친구 수로 나눠, 7일 뒤 재방문 비율을 비교합니다. 친구가 재방문을 늘렸다는 인과관계를 뜻하지는 않습니다.

source.query:
WITH filtered_events AS (SELECT * FROM events WHERE {filters}), first_snapshot AS (
 SELECT person_id, min(timestamp) AS first_at,
  argMin(tuple(toString(properties.island_status), toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.friend_count)), toString(properties.friend_bucket)), timestamp) AS snapshot
 FROM filtered_events
 WHERE properties.analytics_environment = 'production'
  AND event = 'social_state_observed'
  AND toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Seoul')) >= toDate(toTimeZone(now(), 'Asia/Seoul')) - INTERVAL 27 DAY
  AND timestamp <= now()
 GROUP BY person_id
), cohort AS (
 SELECT person_id, toDate(toTimeZone(first_at, 'Asia/Seoul')) AS cohort_day,
  if(tupleElement(snapshot, 2) >= 0 AND tupleElement(snapshot, 3) IN ('0','1','2-4','5+'), tupleElement(snapshot, 3), 'unknown') AS friend_bucket
 FROM first_snapshot
 WHERE tupleElement(snapshot, 1) = 'member'
), active_days AS (
 SELECT person_id, toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Seoul')) AS active_day
 FROM filtered_events
 WHERE properties.analytics_environment = 'production'
  AND event = 'app_active'
  AND toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Seoul')) >= toDate(toTimeZone(now(), 'Asia/Seoul')) - INTERVAL 27 DAY
  AND timestamp <= now()
 GROUP BY person_id, active_day
), per_user AS (
 SELECT c.person_id, c.friend_bucket, c.cohort_day,
  max(if(a.active_day = c.cohort_day + INTERVAL 7 DAY, 1, 0)) AS returned
 FROM cohort c
 LEFT JOIN active_days a ON c.person_id = a.person_id
 GROUP BY c.person_id, c.friend_bucket, c.cohort_day
), aggregated AS (
 SELECT friend_bucket,
  countIf(cohort_day + INTERVAL 7 DAY < toDate(toTimeZone(now(), 'Asia/Seoul'))) AS mature_n,
  countIf(cohort_day + INTERVAL 7 DAY < toDate(toTimeZone(now(), 'Asia/Seoul')) AND returned = 1) AS returned_n
 FROM per_user
 GROUP BY friend_bucket
)
SELECT friend_bucket AS "첫 관측 친구 구간",
 nullIf(mature_n, 0) AS "D7 성숙 분모",
 if(mature_n = 0, NULL, returned_n) AS "D7 재방문자",
 round(100.0 * returned_n / nullIf(mature_n, 0), 2) AS "D7 재방문율 퍼센트"
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY multiIf(friend_bucket = '0', 1, friend_bucket = '1', 2, friend_bucket = '2-4', 3, friend_bucket = '5+', 4, 5)

tiles.title: 섬에 합류한 방법
tiles.description: 최근 28일에 섬을 직접 만들거나, 가입하거나, 승인을 받아 합류한 사람의 수입니다. 한 사람이 여러 방법으로 합류하면 각 항목에 포함됩니다.

source.query:
WITH filtered_events AS (SELECT * FROM events WHERE {filters})
SELECT
 multiIf(properties.method = 'created', '생성', properties.method = 'joined', '가입', properties.method = 'approved', '승인', '미확인') AS "활성화 방식",
 uniqExact(person_id) AS "사용자 수"
FROM filtered_events
WHERE properties.analytics_environment = 'production'
 AND event = 'island_membership_activated'
 AND toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Seoul')) >= toDate(toTimeZone(now(), 'Asia/Seoul')) - INTERVAL 27 DAY
 AND timestamp <= now()
GROUP BY "활성화 방식"
ORDER BY "사용자 수" DESC
